verdict.line: You lose if you let Cho'Gath land Q (Rupture) uncontested and trade into Vorpal Spikes stacks; you win by kiting with W (Hyper) and E (Hop) resets and forcing him to burn Q to engage.

brief.thesis: This matchup is even (50.7% over 140 games) because Gnar's range and mobility answer Cho'Gath's lack of a gap closer, but Cho'Gath's Q (Rupture) has 950 range and knocks Gnar up, erasing his kiting advantage for its duration and opening a trade into W (Feral Scream) silence. Whoever manages cooldowns better wins each all-in: Gnar wants Q (Boomerang Throw) and E (Hop) off cooldown to disengage, Cho'Gath wants Rupture up to engage.

theirWindow.when: Rupture off cooldown, you're in its 950 range
theirWindow.what: Respect the knockup — he only needs you airborne for a second to land Feral Scream's silence and follow with Vorpal Spikes autos. Stay at max range or behind minions until Rupture is on cooldown (9s) before extending.

yourWindow.when: Rupture just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your 9-second trade window. Walk up, throw Q (Boomerang Throw) for the slow, auto for Hyper's bonus damage and move speed, then disengage before Rupture comes back up.

powerCurve.note: Neither has full kit; respect Rupture range
Rupture-Feral Scream combo punishes short trades hard
Your Mega Gnar form threatens all-ins back
Boots and Trinity give you kiting tempo
Feast stacks make his all-in scarier again

start.why: The 45.9% winrate pick (61.2% pick rate) gives sustain and AD to answer Vorpal Spikes poke in extended trades.

boots.why: 51.4% winrate over 111 games — the tenacity cuts the lockdown window after you get caught by Rupture or hit by Feral Scream's silence.

core.why: Core first item in both top build paths — the move speed proc is what lets you actually kite Cho'Gath instead of trading face to face.
Second item in the 58.8% and 54.5% winrate paths — shred his stacking health pool from Feast as the game goes long.
Third item in the top path (58.8% over 34 games) — the shield absorbs a Rupture-into-Feast all-in attempt.

situational.when: he's building toward a late-game all-in with Feast stacks and you need the active slow to peel
he's building magic resist or pokes you down with Vorpal Spikes in extended trades
he's stacking raw health through Feast and you need percent-health damage to keep up

runes.keystoneWhy: 55.8% winrate pick — the heal and move speed proc on a 3-hit trade pattern is exactly what you need to poke with Q (Boomerang Throw) and auto, then walk out before Rupture resets. Lethal Tempo is the master-tier alternative (2,225 games) for players confident enough to stand in extended auto trades rather than kite.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 71.6% of games at 46.8% winrate — Teleport lets you reset for Trinity Force components and keeps your wave-clear advantage from costing you map presence.

playing.title: Track Rupture's 9-second cooldown
playing.detail: Only commit to extended trades in the window right after he whiffs or lands Rupture. Walking into range while it's up gets you knocked up into a silence combo.

playing.title: Poke with ranged Q, don't melee trade
playing.detail: Boomerang Throw at 1100 range outranges his entire kit except Rupture. Throw it, catch it on return for the cooldown refund, and keep distance.

playing.title: Save E (Hop) to escape, not engage
playing.detail: At 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cooldown early on, Hop is your only tool to bounce out of Rupture range. Don't burn it chasing — hold it for when he commits Q.

playing.title: Transform into Mega Gnar on his cooldowns
playing.detail: Rage caps from auto-trading; time your transformation to land when his Rupture and Feral Scream are both down so Mega Gnar's E (Crunch) area damage and R (GNAR!) wall-stun can't be answered.

playing.title: Respect Feast after level 6
playing.detail: Feast deals high true damage at 175 range and grows his max health on a kill. Don't let him walk you down to point-blank range once he has it up.

playing.title: Deny Carnivore kills on minions near you
playing.detail: He sustains off kill resets from Carnivore — don't let him freely last-hit casters under your tower when he's low, since that heals him back into the next trade.

playing.title: Use Teleport to punish his lack of mobility
playing.detail: Cho'Gath has no dash. If you've shoved the wave, Teleport back mid-wave to reset tempo and deny him the freeze he wants to set up Rupture engages.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timings are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid beint hit with (Q) while using the third stack on [W] and [E] to dodge and kite to gain control over lane.
